observation.command:
cd /workspace && for f in \
 externalPackages/materialize/materialIcons/materialIcons.css \
 externalPackages/materialize/materialize.css \
 src/css/dataExplorer.css \
 externalPackages/flatpickr.min.css \
 externalPackages/materialize/materialize.min.js \

 externalPackages/d3/d3-scale-radial.js \
 externalPackages/leaflet/leaflet.js \
 externalPackages/Leaflet.markercluster/dist/leaflet.markercluster-src.js \
 externalPackages/flatpickr.min.js \
 src/js/configurators/DataExplorerConfigurator.js \
 src/js/controllers/ProfilingController.js \
 src/js/helpers/I18nTranslator.js \
 src/js/helpers/BaseUtils.js ; do
 code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/$f); echo "$code  $f"; done
